mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users ( email, password_hash, nickname, preferred_transport ) VALUES ( #{email}, #{passwordHash}, #{nickname}, #{preferredTransport} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, email, password_hash AS passwordHash, nickname, default_start_location AS defaultStartLocation, preferred_transport AS preferredTransport, is_active AS isActive FROM users WHERE email = #{email} AND is_active = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET nickname = #{nickname}, default_start_location = #{defaultStartLocation}, preferred_transport = #{preferredTransport}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{userId}
